scenes.tts: If one glomerulus spreads its output all over the cortex, is the chemistry lost?
scenes.visual: Title card: How a Scatter Keeps Similarity. One glomerulus with axons spraying across the cortex sheet.
scenes.narration: If one glomerulus spreads its output all over the cortex, is the chemistry lost?

scenes.tts: First, what does similar mean for a whole population of neurons?
scenes.visual: A grid of cortical neurons, all grey.
scenes.narration: First, what does similar mean for a whole population of neurons?

scenes.tts: Record many piriform neurons while a mouse smells odour A. Write down each neuron's response.
scenes.visual: Odour A is given; neurons light at various brightness. A column of responses fills in beside the grid.
scenes.narration: Record many piriform neurons while a mouse smells odour A. Write down each neuron's response.

scenes.tts: This one fired. That one did not. A third fired a little. That list is A's population pattern.
scenes.visual: Three neurons pointed out: bright, dark, dim. The column is labelled: population pattern for A.
scenes.narration: This one fired. That one did not. A third fired a little. That list is A's population pattern.

scenes.tts: Do the same for odour B. Two odours are represented similarly if many of the same neurons respond to both.
scenes.visual: A second column for B appears; rows where both columns are lit are highlighted.
scenes.narration: Do the same for odour B. Two odours are represented similarly if many of the same neurons respond to both.

scenes.tts: Real analyses correlate the responses of many neurons. That is a related measure, but not the same number.
scenes.visual: Label: overlap here; correlation in real analyses. Related, not identical.
scenes.narration: Real analyses correlate the responses of many neurons. That is a related measure, but not the same number.

scenes.tts: Now the wiring. Tracing found that each piriform neuron gets input from several glomeruli spread across the bulb.
scenes.visual: One cortical neuron with input lines running back to several glomeruli spread across the bulb. Label: Miyamichi and colleagues, 2011.
scenes.narration: Now the wiring. Tracing found that each piriform neuron gets input from several glomeruli spread across the bulb.

scenes.tts: Driving one glomerulus did not make the cells fire. In this simple model, a neuron fires only when enough inputs are active together.
scenes.visual: A voltage bar inside the neuron. One active input lifts it partway; two together cross a threshold line and the neuron spikes. Label: Davison and Ehlers, 2011.
scenes.narration: Driving one glomerulus did not make the cells fire. In this simple model, a neuron fires only when enough inputs are active together.

scenes.tts: Nothing about the neuron's position enters the model.
scenes.visual: The neuron slides to another place in the sheet; its inputs stay the same, and so does its response.
scenes.narration: Nothing about the neuron's position enters the model.

scenes.tts: Here is a toy. Each neuron listens to two glomeruli and fires only if both are active. Wiring is random.
scenes.visual: A toy neuron with exactly two input wires to two glomeruli. Label: fires only if both are active.
scenes.narration: Here is a toy. Each neuron listens to two glomeruli and fires only if both are active. Wiring is random.

scenes.tts: Odour A activates ten glomeruli. A related ester, B, also activates ten, and shares six with A.
scenes.visual: A row of glomeruli. A's 10 light gold; B's 10 light blue; 6 are both colours. On screen: A = 10, B = 10, shared = 6.
scenes.narration: Odour A activates ten glomeruli. A related ester, B, also activates ten, and shares six with A.

scenes.tts: An unrelated amine, C, shares none.
scenes.visual: C's glomeruli light green, none overlapping A's. On screen: C shared = 0.
scenes.narration: An unrelated amine, C, shares none.

scenes.tts: Any pair of A's glomeruli can feed a neuron. Those neurons respond to A. The pairs are counted on screen.
scenes.visual: Lines join every pair of A's 10 glomeruli. On screen: 10 × 9 / 2 = 45 input pairs, each feeding equally many neurons on average.
scenes.narration: Any pair of A's glomeruli can feed a neuron. Those neurons respond to A. The pairs are counted on screen.

scenes.tts: Which of them also respond to B? Only neurons whose two inputs both sit among the six shared glomeruli.
scenes.visual: Only pairs inside the 6 shared glomeruli stay lit. On screen: 6 × 5 / 2 = 15.
scenes.narration: Which of them also respond to B? Only neurons whose two inputs both sit among the six shared glomeruli.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. The odours share sixty percent of their glomeruli. What share of A's neurons also respond to B?
scenes.visual: On screen: shared glomeruli 60%. Shared neurons: ?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. The odours share sixty percent of their glomeruli. What share of A's neurons also respond to B?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: About one third, on average. The odours share most of their glomeruli, but only a third of their responsive neurons.
scenes.visual: On screen: 15 / 45 = 1/3, about 33%, beside 60% of glomeruli.
scenes.narration: About one third, on average. The odours share most of their glomeruli, but only a third of their responsive neurons.

scenes.tts: And for C, no A neuron responds at all, because no glomeruli are shared.
scenes.visual: C's column: 0 shared neurons. On screen: overlap = 0.
scenes.narration: And for C, no A neuron responds at all, because no glomeruli are shared.

scenes.tts: Two results follow. B is still far more like A than C is. The order of similarity survives.
scenes.visual: A ranking bar: A to B high, A to C zero. Label: order kept.
scenes.narration: Two results follow. B is still far more like A than C is. The order of similarity survives.

scenes.tts: But the overlap has shrunk. Both of a neuron's inputs must be shared, so six tenths times five ninths gives one third.
scenes.visual: On screen: 6/10 × 5/9 = 1/3, close to 0.6 squared = 0.36. Label: related odours less alike.
scenes.narration: But the overlap has shrunk. Both of a neuron's inputs must be shared, so six tenths times five ninths gives one third.

scenes.tts: Where the neurons sit never entered the calculation.
scenes.visual: The toy neurons shuffle to random positions; the counts on screen do not change.
scenes.narration: Where the neurons sit never entered the calculation.

scenes.tts: A larger toy, with a thousand glomeruli and twenty inputs per neuron, gives the same two results.
scenes.visual: Schematic, not data: a scatter plot with bulb overlap on the x axis, cortex overlap on the y axis, and a diagonal line. Label: schematic conditional overlap for the specified toy, related pairs.
scenes.narration: A larger toy, with a thousand glomeruli and twenty inputs per neuron, gives the same two results.

scenes.tts: The order is kept. Related odours become less alike, not more.
scenes.visual: Schematic: related pairs rise from left to right in order and sit below the diagonal.
scenes.narration: The order is kept. Related odours become less alike, not more.

scenes.tts: So in this model, where a neuron sits does not matter. Which glomeruli feed it does.
scenes.visual: On screen, in this model: position does not enter; which glomeruli feed it does.
scenes.narration: So in this model, where a neuron sits does not matter. Which glomeruli feed it does.

scenes.tts: So here is a test for real data. If piriform worked like this model, related odours should be less alike there, not more.
scenes.visual: Two bars, bulb input and cortex; the cortex bar is drawn shorter than the input bar. Label: this model's prediction.
scenes.narration: So here is a test for real data. If piriform worked like this model, related odours should be less alike there, not more.

scenes.tts: In this model, random wiring keeps the expected order of likeness, but makes related odours less alike. Anything tighter needs more than this model.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: in this sparse toy, random wiring keeps the expected order and makes related odours less alike. Anything tighter needs more than this model.
scenes.narration: In this model, random wiring keeps the expected order of likeness, but makes related odours less alike. Anything tighter needs more than this model.
